newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 1.58 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 1.58 pct in January.

text.p: Brazil's Indice Geral de Precos - Disponibilidade Interna (IGP-DI) rose 1.58 percent in January, against a 0.88 percent advance in December, the independent research institute Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said.

The IGP-DI index is a compilation of three indices -- the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 1.67 percent in the period; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 1.85 percent; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.32 percent.
The FGV releases the IGP-DI figure once a month.
